answer: Here is one mechanism: only answered epochs pay, each epoch's emission pool is fixed, and rewards split across verified answers, so extra volume dilutes rather than multiplies income. Today's words line up with the mechanism: saffron maps onto the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, velvet stands for the fixed size of each epoch's emission pool, and juniper mirrors the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work. Flooding the network buys a shrinking slice of a fixed pool while still burning real compute on every submission.
